name: us-two-rebellions
description: Two Rebellions: A Tale of Two Governments — Unit 3 U.S. History game (TEKS 8.15B, 8.5A, 8.17B, 8.1A). Run the national government twice: 1786 against Shays' Rebellion under the Articles of Confederation (every lever fails), then 1794 against the Whiskey Rebellion under the Constitution (the same levers work). Server-authoritative Socket.IO backend with a live Teacher Command Center.
comment: No npm workspaces: this drive is exFAT, which cannot host the symlinks/junctions workspace linking requires. server/ and client/ install independently; `npm install` here cascades via postinstall.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --no-fund --no-audit && npm install --prefix client --no-fund --no-audit
